about_the_game:
PolyClassic Wild VR is an arcade VR first-person shooter that immerses you in the wild and chaotic world of the Wild West. Put on your VR headset, grab your weapons, and become the hero of your own western adventure!

Gameplay

Experience a true VR arcade shooter where you're not just watching the action — you're in the thick of it. Every movement counts: aim precisely, react swiftly, and move skillfully to survive. No auto-cover or auto-aim — just you, your weapons, and waves of enemies from all directions. As you progress, unlock new weapons, and face increasingly intense and insane levels.

Style

The game features stylized low-poly graphics with classic western elements. Bright colors, simplified forms, and atmospheric settings: wooden towns, deserts, canyons, barricades, trains, and dusty streets. All enhanced by visual effects of gunfire, explosions, and flying enemy bodies, turning each battle into a spectacular attraction.

Key Features

  • Intuitive weapon interaction: grab, reload, and shoot with both hands

  • Reactive combat: dodge, take cover, and engage in close-quarters battles

  • Arcade dynamics: constant action and spectacular shootouts

  • Variety of weapons: from classic pistols and shotguns to miniguns and rocket launchers

  • Enemies and bosses: each with unique mechanics requiring different approaches

  • Stylized graphics: low-poly style and immersive Wild West atmosphere

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8, 10, 11 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel core i5-9xxx
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
